summary: Network session startup dispatcher. Reads the network system pointer at obj+0x1B79C (obj is *this) and, when non-null, queries capability via sub_563E70 (setting a flag through SetFlagIfPointerNonNull if capable) and initialises it with DirectDrawDisplayModeInit. On DirectDrawDisplayModeInit success, branches on the global network type dword_7D0E74: value 1 takes the internet path (InitWrapper on the network pointer with mode 1), otherwise the LAN path (MultiStageInitializationChainWithErrorChecking over the port range word_7D0FE8..word_7D0FE8+99). Both paths gate developer logging on dword_7C569C != 5 and emit a StartInternetUpdate or StartLanUpdate debug message via StringSplitLoop/DebugLogWrite. Called by StateResetAndConditionalInit (00475530).

local_names.this: session/state object whose first DWORD (this+0x0) is a pointer to the containing object obj
local_names.result: carries the last called function's return value, returned at function exit
local_names.obj: object obtained from *this; its network system pointer sits at obj+0x1B79C

operations.description: Entire body gated on the network system pointer at obj+0x1B79C (obj = *this) being non-null; when null the function returns immediately with result = *this
Capability query sub_563E70; when non-zero, SetFlagIfPointerNonNull is applied to the network system pointer at obj+0x1B79C
DirectDrawDisplayModeInit run on the network system pointer at obj+0x1B79C; its result drives the failure branch that still proceeds with network initialisation
Network type dispatch: global dword_7D0E74 equal to 1 selects the internet path, any other value selects the LAN path
Internet path: InitWrapper(network ptr, 1) initialises the internet network mode
Developer-logging gate: both init paths check global dword_7C569C != 5 (session type 5 suppressed) before emitting their start message
Internet logging: StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_1, 5776) gates a DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aStartingIntern) "Starting internet update" message
LAN path: MultiStageInitializationChainWithErrorChecking(word_7D0FE8, word_7D0FE8+99, 1) initialises the LAN network across the port range of the session port base
LAN logging: StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_1, 5765) gates a DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aStartingLanUpd) "Starting LAN update" message
Returns the last stored result: the DirectDrawDisplayModeInit return value, the logging gate result, or *this when the network pointer was null
Invoked by StateResetAndConditionalInit (00475530) as part of session/state conditional initialisation
